full_judgment: 2. The opposite parties being plaintiff instituted Other Class Suit No. 184 of 2010 in the Court of learned Joint District Judge, Bandarban. Suit was transferred to the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Bandarban and the suit was renumbered as Other Class Suit No. 106 of 2015. In the plaint the plaintiff stated inter alia that land measuring 2.56 acre in the holding Nos. 52, 34, 154 appertaining to Khatian No. 46 under 288 Alikadam Mouza of AliKadam Police Station, Bandarban Hill District was recorded in the name of Krasing Tonchaingya. Subsequently, Krasing Tonchaingya sold out of 1.53 acre of land out of 2.56 to Liakat Ali, Zinnath Ali, Saber Miah, Abdur Rahim, Ramath Ali and Md Zalcaria and the land was recorded in their names through Mutation Case No. Ak 35/1995. They have been owning and possessing the land since their purchase. While they were possessing the land, .the defendant dispossessed them on 15-8-2010 in their absence from 0.10 decimal of land in plot No. 1284 out of 1.50 acre of their purchased land. The defendant had no right title and interest in the suit land. The defendant No.1 claimed to have purchased 0.10 decimals of land appertaining to the same khatian from plaintiff No.4. An application was filed before the Deputy Commissioner Bandarban and an enquiry was held. In the inquiry report it is alleged that the defendant No.6 was possessing a piece of land measuring 513 feet within ten decimals land appertaining to the same khatian. Earlier defendant Nos. 1-2 and two others dispossessed the plaintiff from a portion of their land in the year of 2008 and when they were dispossessed, one co-sharer of the plaintiff filed Other Class Suit No. 24 of 2008. After filing of the suit the land was released and made over the possession to the plaintiffs. It is further alleged in the plaint that cause of action was arisen on 15-7-2010. Since the plaintiffs were dispossessed illegally, they filed the instant suit under section 9 of the Specific Relief Act, for recovery of their khas possession.
